description: This file is a shell script designed to perform performance testing on git's grep command with various regex patterns and thread configurations. It sets up tests, checks prerequisites, and runs grep commands with different patterns and thread counts, primarily to measure or validate the behavior and performance of 'git grep' with Perl-compatible regex engine.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up and executes performance testing on a large repository.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Prepares and tests the checkout of the worktree for performance testing.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets required prerequisites for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a prerequisite condition is met before proceeding with tests.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified command and prerequisites.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of testing procedures.
